**Instructions:**

        elif n == 1:

        else:

$$
a(0) = 512,\quad a(1) = 768,\quad a(2) = 1152,\quad a(3) = 1280,\quad a(4) = 1408,\quad a(5) = 1664

### Final Recurrence Relation

Let $ d(n) $ be the increment at step $ n $, defined as:

$$
d(n) = 
\begin{cases}
256 & \text{if } n \mod 4 = 0 \\
384 & \text{if } n \mod 4 = 1 \\
128 & \text{if } n \mod 4 = 2 \\
128 & \text{if } n \mod 4 = 3
\end{cases}
$$

Then the recurrence relation for the sequence is:

$$
\boxed{a(n) = a(n-1) + d(n)}
$$

with initial value $ a(0) = 512 $.
